{{Youmay|the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] capitol|the [[Assembly House (Gaftikar)|Assembly House]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]]}}
The '''Assembly House''' was where the [[Government Assembly]], the republic of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Species/Legends|species]], convened. It was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Weogar/Legends|Weogar]], the cultural center of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Each of Clak'dor's city-states sent representatives to the Government Assembly. Although the city-states varied in their methods of selecting representatives, from election to hereditary appointment, all were equal in the Assembly House.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds" />
